newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's EDP says electricity prices to fall.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's EDP says electricity prices to fall.

text.p: Electricity prices will fall between one and six percent in real terms in 1997, state electricity company EDP Electricidade de Portugal SA said in a statement.
The company said prices of electricity for business use would be cut by a nominal three percent during peak hours and between three and five percent during off-peak times, with effect from January 1.

Prices for domestic use would fall around 1.5 percent in real terms. The government, which plans to sell a stake in EDP early next year, forecasts inflation will be between 2.25 and 2.50 percent in 1997.
